problem: A whole-SN guard rejected allocator changes outside the Server target. Rust was already running under a plan that rehashed the unstarted Go peer bytes, so correcting the Go job would have invalidated healthy Rust. The Go owner remained unstarted; no product failure was inferred.
implementation: Shared immutable USER command paths, unit, cgroup and limits; caller-local immutable adopted job/runner/source pins. The authenticated selected physical regular-file namespace is compared to base Git blobs, including ignored/index-hidden files, modes and missing/moved entries. Selected and ancestor symlinks are refused; unrelated subtrees are not traversed. Nonblocking no-follow open and descriptor/path identity checks refuse replacement races.
unchanged_guards: shared fixed baseline and resource floors
own active source and executable custody
durable actual waits and test classifications
scope_limit: This helper does not infer dependency closure or qualify binaries; the caller must authenticate a complete scope and retain its existing resource/child guards. No live or historical adapter was changed.
